Yes, thanks everyone for the great session this morning and all the great disinfo resources overall. I think the policy piece is intimidating for a lot of field folks
partly because the subject matter on this expertise on these tech policy/governance issues among the DRG cadre is so nascent, but even for folks aware of the
issues, it's a huge operational challenge to engage -- in Ukraine it was PAS and FCS who held (and were very proprietary about) relationships with the tech
platforms and there were issues at times with our local partners' advocacy/roles vis-a-vis the interagency. Deep-dives places like BiH or Malaysia with more
specifics on how programs/missions have approached this would be valuable, I think, and might suss out other issues that the field is facing and could inform an
action plan. Just some random thoughts.
Ann
Ann Hopper
Senior Policy Advisor
CPS/OTI
